edits.original: and close to the C4-versus-CAM split, spatial packing is the C4 case, temporal packing is the CAM one.

edits.reason: The original phrasing is garbled and redundant; tightening clarifies the distinction without the awkward 'close to the split' construction.

edits.original: Breeders select dwarfing alleles on purpose, rather than by accident.
